duration.text: The Information Management and E-commerce at University of Electronic Science and Technology of China is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 8.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Two recommendation letters from persons with professional title of associate professor or above; Healthy; Age range from 18 to 40;
